subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Codex app-server WebSocket opening handshakes permanently fail after 30 seconds, with `exit` remaining sufficient when no transport `error` listener is registered?
rationale: The timeout correctly bounds a real hang, but the exact deadline and terminal-event semantics can intentionally stop existing slow connections and are not defined by upstream Codex.

options.title: Approve the bounded contract
options.body: Remove the unrelated APNs change, retain the 30-second deadline, and document through focused tests that timeout emits the expected error and terminal exit sequence.

options.title: Choose another deadline
options.body: Select a different owner-approved constant while keeping the same shared TCP and Unix timeout mechanism and regression coverage.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Keep the PR open until live Codex app-server evidence or an upstream contract establishes the acceptable deadline and terminal signals.
